title: Trade Equity Credit by Condition Grade on Kestrel Auto Finance Orders under Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Trade equity.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, the trade equity of the accepted agreement in Trade-In Agreements linked to the order is its current offer less the latest payoff quote recorded on that agreement, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent. When no payoff quote is recorded, nothing is taken off the offer; when several are recorded, the latest by date is used.

**Credit by condition grade.** Trade equity counts toward the down payment credits by the trade's condition grade:

| Condition grade of the accepted trade-in | Equity counted |
|---|---|
| Rough Condition Offer or Inoperable Condition Offer | 75 percent (the rough trade share), rounded half up to the cent |
| Fair Condition Offer | 90 percent (the fair trade share), rounded half up to the cent |
| Good Condition Offer, Very Good Condition Offer or Excellent Condition Offer | in full |

**Worked examples (hypothetical trade-ins).**
- Fair Condition Offer, current offer $8000.00, payoff quotes of $5600.00 and then $5500.00: equity $2500.00, counted at 90 percent, $2250.00.
- Rough Condition Offer, current offer $3100.00, no payoff quote: equity $3100.00, counted at 75 percent, $2325.00.
- Inoperable Condition Offer, current offer $1250.00, payoff quote $1400.00: equity $0.00.
- Very Good Condition Offer, current offer $12000.00, payoff quote $7000.00: $5000.00 counts in full.
- A trade-in offer not accepted, or not linked to the order: no trade equity.
